_comment: Single source of truth for the Home FAQ. Each entry references the i18n key pair (question + answer) in the 'home' namespace. gen_home_faq.js renders BOTH the visible <details> accordion (translatable via data-i18n) AND the FAQPage JSON-LD (English canonical) from this one ordered list, so the two can never drift. To add, remove or reorder a question, edit this list and its i18n keys, then run gen_home_faq.js.
